title: Amazing Dutch Coconut Pudding
description: A traditional Dutch dessert featuring coconut flakes and a unique ice-bath-shock technique, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly pudding is a show-stopping treat with a jammy and springy texture.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together coconut milk, sugar, and cornstarch.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in toasted coconut flakes, egg yolks, vanilla extract, and salt.
Strain the mixture into a clean bowl and place it in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, whip the pudding with a fork to create a light and airy texture.
Spoon the pudding into individual serving cups and garnish with additional toasted coconut flakes if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
